text: In 1952, she was the fastest ocean liner ever built.
Nine hundred ninety feet long, she crossed the Atlantic at over thirty-five knots, a record no liner has beaten since.
Retired in 1969, she spent the next half century rusting at a pier.
On November eleventh, 2026, off Destin, Florida, crews sank her. No explosives. Just water.
After a stubborn valve held things up, she settled level and slipped under.
She landed upright, a hundred eighty feet down. The world's largest artificial reef.
